questions.stem: Let \(p(x)\) be a polynomial. When \(p(x)\) is divided by \((x-1)\), it leaves 2 as the remainder. When \(p(x)\) is divided by \((x-2)\), it leaves 1 as the remainder. What is the remainder when \(p(x)\) is divided by \((x-1)(x-2)\)?

Consider the following in respect of a positive real number \(x\) :

I. \(x+\frac{1}{x}>1\)

II. \(\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2>2\)

III. \(\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^4>9\)

Which of the above are correct?
flags: Subtopic is a loose fit: this is an AM-GM style inequality in \(x+1/x\), not a linear inequality.

questions.stem: Let \(p\) and \(q\) be natural numbers such that \(q>p\). What is the largest value of \(p\) such that \(q^2-5p-4\) is negative?

questions.stem: Let \(x\) and \(y\) be natural numbers, each less than 20, such that \(x\), \(y\), \(x+y\) and \(x-y\) are prime numbers. How many such combinations of \((x,\ y,\ x+y,\ x-y)\) are possible?
If \((x+1)(x+p)(x^2+p^2)=x^4-1\), then what is the value of \(p\)?
If \((2+\sqrt{3})^x+(2-\sqrt{3})^x=2\), then what is \((2+\sqrt{3})^x-(2-\sqrt{3})^x\) equal to?
If \(\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}=\frac{5}{6}\) and \(\frac{1}{a^2}+\frac{1}{b^2}=\frac{13}{36}\), then what is \(\frac{1}{a^3}+\frac{1}{b^3}\) equal to?
What is the remainder when \(x^6\) is divided by \(x^2+1\)?
\((x+2)\) is a factor of which one of the following?
If \(\log_{10}2=0.301\) and \(\log_{10}3=0.477\), then what is the number of digits in the expansion of \(60^{60}\)?

What is the remainder when

\((17^{25}+19^{25})\)

is divided by 18?

The HCF of \(x\) and \(y\) is \(H\). Consider the following statements in respect of the HCF of \(p=\frac{x^3+y^3}{x^2-xy+y^2}\) and \(q=\frac{x^3-y^3}{x^2+xy+y^2}\) :

I. The HCF of \(p\) and \(q\) can be \(H\).

II. The HCF of \(p\) and \(q\) can be \(2H\).

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
If \(x^4=x^2+1\), where \(x>0\), then what is \(2x^4\) equal to?

questions.stem: If \(\frac{p+q}{q+r}=\frac{r+s}{s+p}\); \((q+r)\ne 0\), \((s+p)\ne 0\), then which one of the following is correct?
If \(n\) is natural number less than 7, then what is the number of values of \(n\) for which \((12n+2)\) and \((8n+1)\) are relatively prime?
What is the HCF of \(x^3+y^3+3xy-1\) and \((x+y)^4-1\)?

Let \(x=n(n+1)(n+2)\), where \(n\) is an even natural number. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. \(x\) is always divisible by 48.

II. \(x^2\) is always divisible by 144.

Select the answer using the code given below.
What is the LCM of \(x^4+x^2y^2+y^4\), \(x^3y+y^4\) and \(x^4y^2-x^3y^3\)?
Let \(XYZ\) be a 3-digit number. Let \(D\) be the difference between \(XYZ\) and \(ZYX\). What is the remainder when \(D\) is divided by 99?
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be two natural numbers such that \((p+q)^{p+q}\) is divisible by 512. What is the least value of \((p+q)\)?

What is

\(\frac{(a+b)^2}{(c-a)(c+a+b)}+\frac{(a+b)c}{c^2+bc-a^2-ab}-\frac{(a+2b+c)}{2(c-a)}\), \(a\ne b\), \(b\ne c\), \(c\ne a\)

equal to?

If \(a^b=b^a\), then what is

\(\frac{a\times\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{b}}}{a^{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)}}\)

equal to?
If \(\frac{\sqrt{p+x}+\sqrt{p-x}}{\sqrt{p+x}-\sqrt{p-x}}=p\), then what is \(x\) equal to?
If \(\left(\frac{a-b}{2}\right)x^2-\left(\frac{a+b}{2}\right)x+b=0\), then what are the roots of this equation?
